本例屬性可直接讀寫；程式流程透過方法維持規則。

sample=True 保留固定順序；一般遊戲會洗牌。

notes: 選牌尚未改變 face_up，按下一步才翻開。

notes: 比較圖案值，並增加一次比較次數。

zh.title: 結算：保留或蓋回
notes: 相同圖案標記已配對；不同圖案呼叫 hide()。

zh.title: 失敗範例：C03 與 C04
zh.sub: 載入「配對失敗」範例，比較 leaf 與 sun
notes: 蓋回後仍是原來的 Card，不會重新建立兩張牌。
values: leaf 與 sun 都是正面

zh.title: 參照、重設與物件身分
zh.sub: Python 的 is 檢查物件身分
notes: 新遊戲建立新的 Board 與 Card。
外部變數 card 仍能參照上一局的物件。
zh.code:
game = Game(sample=True)
game.play('C01')
card = game.first
print(card is game.board.cards[0])  # True

new_game = Game(sample=True)
print(card is new_game.board.cards[0])  # False
print(card.face_up)                    # True

en.title: Card matching & object state
notes: Each card is an object.
Step through state changes and references.

en.title: Browser game & object labels
en.sub: 12 cards, 6 pairs. Play directly in your browser.
notes: Normal play: choose two cards, then confirm the turn.
Step mode: queue, reveal, compare, and settle.

en.sub: Use a mouse, touch, or keyboard
notes: Switching languages preserves the board and progress. Reloading starts a new game.
values: Choose two cards; confirm the turn
Toggle labels such as C01: Card
Inspect a card without revealing it
Create a new game in step mode
Create new objects and a shuffled board

en.title: Three class responsibilities
en.sub: Keep data and behavior in the responsible object
notes: The view reads model state. Buttons call model methods.

en.title: UML class diagram
en.sub: Name, attributes, methods. Arrows show navigable associations.
notes: One Game has one Board. The Board holds 12 Cards.
first, second, and pending each refer to zero or one Card.

en.title: Equal pictures, distinct objects
en.sub: Fixed board: C01 and C02 both have pair_id = moon
notes: C01 and C02 are separate instances with independent face_up values.
Game.first and Board.cards[0] can refer to the same card.

en.title: Three Card states
en.sub: Two Boolean attributes describe the visible state
notes: A matched card stays face up. hide() leaves it unchanged.

en.title: Card: data and reveal behavior
notes: reveal() rejects cards that are already face up or matched.
Attributes are writable here. The game uses methods to maintain its rules.

en.title: Board: create and keep cards
notes: Each Card(...) call creates a new instance.
sample=True keeps the fixed order. Normal games shuffle.

en.title: Selection: a pending reference
notes: Queuing does not change face_up. The next step reveals it.
A revealed card cannot also be selected as the second card.

en.title: One step: reveal the queued card
en.sub: Reveal branch of Game.step(); other branches call compare() and settle()
notes: first and second hold references to existing Cards.
Each step() completes only one stage.

en.title: Comparison: check pair_id
notes: Compare picture values and count one comparison.
matched is still False until the settlement step.

en.title: Settlement: keep or hide
notes: Equal pictures are marked matched; different ones are hidden.
Temporary references are cleared. Board still holds the cards.

en.title: Match example: C01 and C02
en.sub: Load the Match example, select cards, and use N
notes: Selecting a card only queues it. Each N advances one stage.

en.title: Mismatch example: C03 and C04
en.sub: Load the Mismatch example: leaf versus sun
notes: Hiding changes the existing Cards. It does not create replacements.
values: leaf and sun are face up

en.title: References, reset & identity
notes: A new game creates a new Board and new Cards.
The variable card can still refer to an object from the old game.
en.code:
game = Game(sample=True)
game.play('C01')
card = game.first
print(card is game.board.cards[0])  # True

new_game = Game(sample=True)
print(card is new_game.board.cards[0])  # False
print(card.face_up)                    # True

en.title: Run the Python example
notes: Open a terminal in the extracted memory_oop folder.
Commands: pick C01, step, inspect C01, confirm, sample, quit.
en.code:
python main.py --lang en --sample
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

en.title: Exercises & references
notes: Call hide() after matching. The card should stay face up.
Keep a card reference, start a new game, and compare identities.
Compare languages: === checks object identity in the web version; Python uses is.

values: めくる・裏返す・一致済みにする

ja.title: UML クラス図
ja.sub: 名前・属性・メソッドの三段。矢印は参照可能な関連。
notes: 一つの Game が一つの Board を持ち、Board は 12 枚を保持。
first・second・pending は、それぞれ 0 または 1 枚を参照。

ja.title: 同じ絵、異なるオブジェクト
ja.sub: 固定の盤面：C01 と C02 の pair_id は moon
notes: C01 と C02 は別の実体。face_up は個別に変わります。
Game.first と Board.cards[0] は同じカードを参照できます。

ja.title: Card の三つの状態
ja.sub: 二つの真偽値で表示状態を表す
notes: 一致済みのカードは表のまま。hide() でも裏に戻りません。

ja.title: Card：データとめくる動作
notes: 表向き・一致済みのカードは reveal() で再度めくれません。
属性は直接変更可能ですが、ゲームはメソッドを通してルールを守ります。

ja.title: Board：カードの生成と保持
notes: Card(...) を呼ぶたび、新しい実体を生成します。
sample=True は固定順。通常のゲームではシャッフルします。

ja.title: 選択：pending に参照を保存
notes: 選択だけでは face_up は変わらず、次のステップでめくります。
表向きの同じカードを二枚目として選ぶことはできません。

ja.title: 一歩進む：待機中のカードをめくる
ja.sub: Game.step() のめくる分岐。他の分岐は compare() と settle() を呼ぶ
notes: first・second は既存の Card への参照です。
一回の step() で一段階だけ進みます。

ja.title: 比較：pair_id の一致
notes: 絵の値を比較して、比較回数を 1 増やします。
確定するまで matched は False のままです。

ja.title: 確定：表のまま残すか裏返す
notes: 同じ絵は一致済みに、違う絵は hide() で裏返します。
一時参照を消しても、Board がカードを保持しています。

ja.title: 一致の例：C01 と C02
ja.sub: 「一致」の例を読み込み、選択と N で進める
notes: 選択は待機させるだけ。N を押すたび一段階進みます。

ja.title: 不一致の例：C03 と C04
ja.sub: 「不一致」の例を読み込み、leaf と sun を比較
notes: 裏返すのは元の Card。新しいカードは作りません。
values: leaf と sun が表向き

ja.title: 参照・リセット・同一性
ja.sub: Python の is でオブジェクトの同一性を確認
notes: 新しいゲームは Board と Card を新しく生成します。
変数 card は前のゲームの実体を引き続き参照できます。
ja.code:
game = Game(sample=True)
game.play('C01')
card = game.first
print(card is game.board.cards[0])  # True

new_game = Game(sample=True)
print(card is new_game.board.cards[0])  # False
print(card.face_up)                    # True
